name: NGC 1578, PSN J04234719-5136029 field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1578, the presumed host galaxy of the Type Ia supernova PSN J04234719-5136029, seen by Hubble.
label: psnj04235136-hubble
story: A Type Ia supernova, caught days before it reached its peak, appeared beside this galaxy. Hubble returned later to measure the faint light that lingers where a star has exploded.

claims.text: PSN J04234719-5136029 is a Type Ia supernova observed before maximum; presumed host NGC 1578
